faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Senior Resident (Surgery), 3 Senior Resident (Medicine).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 4 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: PwD (Divyangjan) As per Govt. of India rules upon submission of Handicapped Certificate from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Basic Pay in Level-11 as per 7th Pay Commission for Senior Resident (Surgery), Basic Pay in Level-11 as per 7th Pay Commission for Senior Resident (Medicine).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India; registered with Delhi Medical Council; must not have completed three years Senior Residency. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must hold valid Delhi Medical Council registration or have applied for DMC on or before the date of interview. Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited; cannot work simultaneously as SR in any other hospital. Must wear white coat with name badge on duty; no smoking on duty or while examining patients. May be required to perform duties in Accident & Emergency Department as per patient care requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates arriving after 11:00 AM registration close.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview on 04.11.2026 to 06.11.2026 or till suitable candidates are selected. Separate merit list for candidates who completed 3 years as SR; fresh candidates' list exhausted first.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment for 89 days (44 days where reserved vacancies are filled by General candidates), extendable by 89/44 days with one day break. Maximum tenure of Senior Resident post is 03 years including previous tenure in any Govt. Hospital/Institute/Organization. Services end when a regular appointee joins; no claim over the post.
